title: ROV image shows a straight wall on the anomaly

tellings.quote: I mean I would say that's I must be at least 30 m 30 m at least. 60 m the whole thing.

plain: Dennis Asberg, a treasure hunter, says that in 2025 an image from a remote-controlled underwater robot showed a straight wall on the Baltic Sea anomaly, a strange object his team found on the seafloor between Sweden and Finland. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels the wall must be at least 30 meters long and the whole object about 60 meters, which would make a straight edge that size hard to explain as natural rock.
